Interface ConcurrentEffect<F>

All Superinterfaces:
Applicative<F>, ApplicativeError<F, Throwable>, Async<F>, Bracket<F, Throwable>, Concurrent<F>, Effect<F>, Functor<F>, Monad<F>, MonadError<F, Throwable>, Sync<F>
All Known Implementing Classes:
IO.IOConcurrent
public interface ConcurrentEffect<F> extends Concurrent<F>, Effect<F>
An effect that is both Concurrent and Effect: it can be run, and what runs can start fibers, race and run in parallel. What a server asks for when its handlers may do things at the same time. Like cats-effect 2's ConcurrentEffect.
